title: CHIPS Program National Environmental Policy Act Implementation
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: NIST's CHIPS NEPA page sets out revised environmental-review procedures, applicant information requirements, project review materials, and completed-review records for CHIPS incentives projects.
key_findings: NIST published revised CHIPS programmatic NEPA procedures on June 30, 2025.
The page links applicant forms and project-specific review records, including environmental assessments, findings, environmental impact statements, and records of decision where applicable.
Review artifacts represent distinct procedural stages and must remain separate from award, permit, construction, production, and local outcome evidence.
why_it_matters: The framework provides an official rail for testing environmental-review claims in semiconductor project timelines without converting a review stage into delivery.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project-level environmental-review discovery rail to Chips and Compute.
Supports consistent stage labels across CHIPS-funded facility records.
Provides a bridge from federal project descriptions to local permit, utility, construction, and operating evidence.
evidence_limits: NEPA review does not replace every state, local, or sector permit.
A completed review does not prove construction, schedule, qualification, production, utility capacity, or economic outcomes.
Project descriptions and anticipated impacts can change and should be tied to the exact document and decision stage.
